response.sql: WITH event_counts AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event), shares AS (SELECT event_id, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM event_counts), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST) AS share_rank FROM shares) SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, event_id;
